settings.heading: Watching Your Dog Struggle… And Not Knowing What to Do
settings.text:
It's one of the hardest things to watch. Your dog limping, hesitating to stand up, looking at you like they need help, and you start wondering if you're doing enough.

A torn CCL is the most common knee injury in dogs and a leading cause of hind-leg lameness. The usual surgery often costs thousands of dollars per leg, followed by weeks of crate rest, anaesthesia risk and no guarantee it holds.

For many dogs, vets see conservative management as a valid first step: rest, weight control and supportive bracing to steady the joint while it heals. That's what this brace is made for. It's not a miracle or a replacement for your vet, but a real way to support recovery and protect the other leg too.

settings.heading: Support Their Recovery — Gently, Safely, at Home
settings.text:
This isn't a compression sleeve. It's a dual-leg hinged harness, with a real mechanical hinge at the knee that limits the painful wobble of an unstable joint.

The built-in harness anchors across your dog's chest and back, so the brace stays where you put it. No slipping, no sagging, no worn-out velcro after a week.

And there's the part most single-leg braces ignore: when one knee goes, the other is put under extra strain. This brace supports both hind knees at once, in one harness, from day one.

settings.heading: How It Works
settings.text:
The brace steadies the knee joint so your dog can move with less discomfort while the leg recovers.

  • Supports the knee joint – holds the knee in a safer position, reducing instability from ACL/CCL tears or arthritis.
  • Reduces strain – limits harmful movement to ease pressure on ligaments and the joint.
  • Improves mobility – helps spread weight so the leg is less likely to buckle.
  • Protects the other leg – lowers the strain that comes from over-compensating.
  • Supports recovery at home – safer, gradual movement while the joint heals.

settings.heading: Why This Brace Is Different
settings.text:
You may have already tried a cheap sleeve. It slid off in minutes and the velcro gave out within a week. Now you think braces don't work.

They don't, if they're just compression sleeves with nothing holding them in place.

This one is different in two ways that matter. It has a hinge that steadies the knee, the exact joint that's unstable after a CCL tear. And it has a built-in harness that anchors across your dog's chest and back, so it stays on all day.

It also supports both hind knees at once, because the other knee is now the one most at risk.
